about.title: About Me
about.intro: I build reliable software, end to end.
about.body: I am a senior software developer specializing in scalable, high-performance backend systems. Java and Spring Boot are my core, with Rust and TypeScript alongside them. I own the path from code to production, across containerized services, Kubernetes, Helm and GitOps. I care about clean code, clear abstractions, and well-tested systems that stay straightforward to operate and extend.

experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: From QA to backend and platform work.

bullets.b1: Maintain and further develop the white-label software solutions running on the platform.
bullets.b2: Develop the generalized framework they are built from, so each new partner product starts from shared code.

bullets.b1: Implemented the frontend and backend engine of an internal and external development platform, so teams built and integrated services consistently across the stack.
bullets.b2: Standardized deployments, release strategies and configuration across services and environments with CI/CD and GitOps workflows on Kubernetes.
bullets.b3: Delivered partner-specific features as white-label solutions, so partners shipped customized products on shared core infrastructure and tooling.

bullets.b1: Owned entire products for customers, from REST and gRPC backends through the web frontends and native OS applications built on them.
bullets.b2: Automated dependency updates, security scanning, documentation and scheduled releases in CI, so projects kept themselves current without manual intervention.
bullets.b3: Ran hardened, high-performance Kubernetes on Talos Linux, delivered by GitOps and instrumented with metrics, logs and traces.

bullets.b1: Shipped gameplay and backend features for high-traffic Minecraft minigames, weighing each change against stability and player impact.
bullets.b2: Diagnosed production failures spanning multiple plugins and services, converting vague reports into reproducible cases and fixes.
bullets.b3: Planned and delivered gameplay features with product, community and operations, folding player feedback into the roadmap.

bullets.b1: Reproduced and isolated gameplay and backend failures across a high-traffic Minecraft network, handing developers root causes instead of symptoms.
bullets.b2: Triaged live incidents from player reports and internal monitoring, assessing impact and tracking critical failures to resolution.
bullets.b3: Verified fixes for critical production issues with developers and community staff.
